question: Does daily cooldown regime discovery improve with identical date-level alert counts?
scope: All original daily_cooldown20 lists, all scored era/level/dates, pooled and annual; other strategies unchanged
capacity: Each date K=min(base count, variant count); retain each side top K by frozen score then code. Empty dates retained with K=0. Do not refill or recompute cooldown after thinning: suppressed original alerts still consume original cooldown.
random_control: Independently choose uniform K of original N each day, no seed sampling. Inclusion q=K/N, empty N gives q=0. Original cooldown gap>20 implies at most one same-industry alert within any20-day event window; expected hit=q. Validate that invariant.
outcomes: Fixed original event catalogue including no-alert events; left-censored excluded and counted. Report deterministic recall, expected recall, retained counts, known positive/negative/unknown label counts. Ratio expected positive / expected known explicitly ratio of expectations, not expected precision.
boundaries: Posthoc fixed-output workload diagnostic, not newly validated deployable strategy; no new fitting or thresholds, no adoption, no independent significance.
